newsitem.title: BELGIUM: South African Avgold lists IDRs in Brussels.
newsitem.headline: South African Avgold lists IDRs in Brussels.

text.p: South African gold mines company Avgold on Monday began listing international depositary receipts (IDRs) on the Brussels Stock Exchange, issue co-sponsor Banque Bruxelles Lambert (BBL) said in a statement.
The IDRs are in the form of bearer certificates each representing 50 or 100 underlying Avgold shares, as listed in Johannesburg.
Avgold is a product of the restructuring of South African mines group Anglovaal. It consists of a number of the group's gold mining units including Zandpan
BBL said it produces about 1.1 million ounces of gold a year for a cost of $304 per ounce.
Zandpan shares listed in Brussels can be exchanged for Avgold shares in the ratio of 150 Avgold shares for every 1,000 Zandpan shares. Zandpan's listing in Brussels will be temporarily maintained.

BBL said the Avgold listing was the first undertaken by Soges-Dewaay, a new joint venture between BBL and Belgian brokers Dewaay, Servais & Co set up with the aim of promoting the Brussels Stock Exchange to foreign companies.
